mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_message ( message_id, topic, tag, biz_key, message_type, payload, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{topic}, #{tag}, #{bizKey}, #{messageType}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetryCount}, #{nextRetryTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id, topic, tag, biz_key, message_type, payload, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time, error_message, sent_time, created_at, updated_at FROM local_message WHERE message_id = #{messageId}

SELECT id, message_id, topic, tag, biz_key, message_type, payload, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time, error_message, sent_time, created_at, updated_at FROM local_message WHERE status IN ('INIT', 'FAILED') AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now}) AND retry_count < max_retry_count ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE local_message SET status = 'SENT', sent_time = NOW(), error_message = NULL WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
